system.description:
Range unlimited on the same plane; one creature or object you have seen or hold something belonging to.

  • You learn its exact location (within 10ft), height or depth and the plane.
  • Blocked by Mind Blank, Nondetection and Screen.
  • Cast reversed (Obscure Location): touch one willing creature or object; it cannot be found by any divination for 1 day per level. No save.

Reversible: may be cast as its opposite with the same slot.

Classes: Cleric
system.range: Range unlimited on the same plane
